what: Which desktop applications the accessibility oracle can actually serve, tested by running its own positive and negative controls against eight installed apps.
why_it_matters: The GUI track has always been described as covering 2 applications. That number was never validated against a control, and the constraint turns out to be sharper than 'we only tried two'.

evince.note: Requires a PDF seed. Only naive byte-flip mutation is available: the structure-aware mutator is PNG-only.

NOT_USABLE_and_why.shotwell: THE INTERESTING ONE. Positive control accepted at 83 nodes and NEGATIVE control ALSO accepted at 83 nodes. Shotwell never shows an error element, so the oracle cannot distinguish a refusal from a success and any campaign there would report every input as accepted. Not a bug in the app or the oracle -- a target this oracle cannot serve.
NOT_USABLE_and_why.feh: no_window. Raw X11/imlib2, exports no accessibility interface.
NOT_USABLE_and_why.xpdf: crashed on the control when handed a PNG; it is a PDF viewer. Untested with a PDF seed because it is Motif rather than GTK and exports no a11y tree.
NOT_USABLE_and_why.gthumb: Control REJECTED the unmodified seed, so the seed and the app disagree before any mutation. Fixable with the right seed format; not yet done.

the_real_constraint: The oracle needs an AT-SPI-exporting toolkit, which in practice means GTK3 or later. Of eight installed viewers, two qualify AND discriminate. That is a sharper limit than 'we only tried two applications' and it belongs in the paper as such.
an_environment_defect_found_and_fixed: Running dbus-launch on every invocation created a NEW session bus per campaign while the at-spi launcher stayed bound to the previous one, so app and oracle sat on different buses and EVERY target reported no_window. One persistent session, address exported to all runs. Before the fix evince looked unusable; after it, its controls pass.
also_fixed: GTK stalls before mapping a window with an unwritable HOME or a dconf backend it cannot reach, and says nothing at all. GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory plus a writable HOME made the whole track runnable natively, without the container -- which mattered because the GUI image had to be deleted for disk.
